verdict.rationale: Floot provides a managed Postgres database automatically included with each app (floot-docs-17), with in-builder tools to query/write/migrate and regenerate typed helpers via AI commands (floot-docs-4), plus schema-driven endpoint/table generation from natural-language descriptions (floot-docs-26) and backup/export options (floot-docs-24) all without leaving the builder/chat interface. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of provisioning speed or reliability, and more detail on database configuration options (e.g., choosing engine version, scaling).
